subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change the shipped SearXNG precedence contract so an explicit but unavailable or invalid `baseUrl` fails closed instead of falling through to `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but this changes an existing upgrade-visible fallback and can make previously completing searches stop until an operator repairs or removes the explicit configuration.

options.title: Accept fail-closed precedence
options.body: Treat explicit configuration as authoritative, accept the bounded availability break for misconfigured installations, and merge after the normal base refresh and checks.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep the shipped fallback behavior and close or redesign this PR, accepting that an unavailable explicit endpoint may silently route searches to a different ambient host.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed precedence
recommendation.body: Treat explicit configuration as authoritative, accept the bounded availability break for misconfigured installations, and merge after the normal base refresh and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and substantially shaped the original SearXNG configuration and SecretRef contract.
